SYNTHETIC TEST SHOW - written for this repository's tests; not part of any input pack.
EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: At her ex-fiance's engagement gala, Mia is humiliated and thrown out - until a quiet stranger calls her his wife.
CONTINUITY NOTES: First episode. Establishes Mia, her ex Derek, his new fiancee Brenda, and the stranger Ethan.

Scene heading: EXT. SKYLINE HOTEL ROOFTOP - NIGHT

Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.60)

Start: (00:04.40) | End: (00:05.40)

Start: (00:05.40) | End: (00:07.80)
"Brenda, why are you doing this?"

**DEREK (Cold):**
Start: (00:07.80) | End: (00:10.80)

**MIA (Desperate):**
Start: (00:10.80) | End: (00:13.60)

**DEREK (Smug):**
Start: (00:13.60) | End: (00:17.00)

**BRENDA (Gloating):**
Start: (00:17.00) | End: (00:19.60)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:19.60) | End: (00:21.80)
Two guards grab Mia by both arms and drag her toward the elevator.

**MIA (Struggling, Screaming):**
Start: (00:21.80) | End: (00:23.60)
"Let go of me!"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:23.60) | End: (00:26.60)

**STRANGER IN GREY COAT (Calm, Low):**
Start: (00:23.60) | End: (00:26.20)
"Take your hands off my wife."

**DEREK (Laughing, Mocking):**
Start: (00:26.20) | End: (00:29.20)
"Your wife? She doesn't even have a boyfriend."

**STRANGER IN GREY COAT (Quiet, Firm):**
Start: (00:29.20) | End: (00:31.20)
"She does now."

**DEREK (Furious):**
Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:33.60)
"Do you know who I am? My family owns half this city."

**STRANGER IN GREY COAT (Cold, Menacing):**
Start: (00:33.60) | End: (00:36.20)

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.20) | End: (00:39.20)

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:36.20) | End: (00:37.60)

**MIA (Whispering, Stunned):**
Start: (00:37.60) | End: (00:39.20)
"Who are you?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:39.20) | End: (00:42.20)

**DEREK (Threatening):**
Start: (00:42.20) | End: (00:45.40)

**STRANGER IN GREY COAT (Gentle):**
Start: (00:45.40) | End: (00:48.00)

**MIA (Confused):**
Start: (00:48.00) | End: (00:50.20)

**STRANGER IN GREY COAT (Calm):**

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:52.60) | End: (00:55.20)

**MIA (Shocked):**
Start: (00:55.20) | End: (00:57.40)
